generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
All terms and condition as per tender document

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have experience for carrying out similar type of works that is covered under scope of work related to 220kV Voltage class power transformers. The bidder should have executed such works listed under scope of work for any of the government/public sector power utility.
The Tenderer/Bidder shall provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the last five years with KPTCL.
Self declaration regarding Risk and cost as per NIT and Tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- self declaration regarding risk and cost

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should possess valid Goods and Services Tax (GST) registration, EPF & ESI Certificate and shall upload the scanned copy of GST, PAN, ESI & EPF certificates.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer/Bidder should not have been Blacklisted or disqualified for non-performance in any of the Government utilities in the past five years as on date of Bid opening.

technicalCriterionList.description: Restriction on Land Border Sharing Any Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Bidder is registered with the Competent Authority as per the provision of Government Order No. FD455 EXP 12 2020 Bengaluru dated 01.04.2023.

The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be counter signed by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.
